technical_trigger: Actual provider native time 1-4ms ahead of preserved local receipt floor caused V2 to reject observations. V3 requires a bounded actual-clock barrier instead of rewriting or tolerating future time.

config_requirements.forward: Existing exact scalp7_fresh_forward_v2 and config/source freezes
config_requirements.micro: Original economic identity and signal hash profile; source FREEZE schema scalp7.micro.fresh_producer.v2 accepts original plus all new verified basename code pins
config_requirements.quotes: Existing frozen positive max_quote_request_ms/max_pair_skew_ms/max_quote_gap_ms; no threshold fitting

clock_policy.request_and_receipt_timestamps: Preserved unchanged in immutable HTTP receipt
clock_policy.barrier: Use only after an actual local wall sample reaches max(native timestamp, receipt timestamp)
clock_policy.monotonic_deadline: Elapsed monotonic time must be <=5000ms; fail on reversal or overrun, even if the wall later reaches the target
clock_policy.wall_reversal: Fail closed before preserved receipt or on reversal during quarantine; also fail if final action processing clock reverses after frame refresh
clock_policy.proof: Per-sample wall and monotonic clock evidence, exact native/receipt binding, preserved HTTP body hash and separate immutable clock receipt
clock_policy.pair_admission: Every leg needs proof, available by processing clock; both raw receipt skew and proof usability skew obey the frozen pair policy
clock_policy.total_observation_budget: Request-to-receipt and request-to-proof usability obey the frozen quote request budget
clock_policy.action_time: Entry, exit and partial fill actions use actual final processing clock, sampled after refreshed frames; never earlier raw quote receipt or native timestamp
clock_policy.ledger_time_fields: Keep entry/exit per-leg raw quote times, clock proof usable times and final outcome availability separately

integrity_recovery.consumed_missing_projection: If prior complete offset>0 or prior chain head nonzero, missing signal file raises CONSUMED_SIGNAL_PROJECTION_MISSING_HOLD before quotes/state commit
integrity_recovery.not_yet_created_unconsumed_projection: Empty cursor can wait for initial signal file
integrity_recovery.state_boundary: Snapshot failure during either prequote or postquote frame load does not persist pending entries, observations, signal cursors or economic state; raw quote audit files may remain
integrity_recovery.other_failures: Unknown or similarly named errors remain HOLD; no broad future timestamp allowance
integrity_recovery.restart: Atomic authoritative STATE and immutable prefix/hash chain checks retained from V2

validation.test_only_final_change: Any annotations for dynamic mocked module fixtures; no runtime change

validation_scope: Deterministic implementation fixtures only. No historical, rolling, fresh economic run and no services started by implementation author.
paper_limits: Observed quote paper is distinct from exchange/account fills and historical OHLC execution.
Sparse quotes do not prove complete price path, capacity or slippage.
Cost reserve remains separately frozen 1x/2x research deduction in addition to observed bid/ask gross.
Original evidence and zero-fill operational failures remain separate; no retroactive fills or attribution.
